chunk_map.heading: The more you trust it, the less you notice

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "it also makes you a little worse at spotting the one that is wrong" is closest: 'it' = the agent, named in the same sentence's first clause; 'this kind of work' (L10) resolves to the work-by-hand habit of L8.
L6 "On Day 2 each of you marked the one digest line you trusted least" is closest: names the day and what was done, not a file by position; unpacked in-sentence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 "marked the one digest line you trusted least": apt101-read-the-digest.expanded.md L58 '## Phase 2: Mark the line you trust least' and L69 appends to team/<my-name>/doubts.md; the beat exists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal demo beat; L6 questions are reflection prompts with no outcome narrated

rules_evaluated.evidence: Single slide with self-carrying claim at L4 "Each good result is real evidence that it can be trusted, and it also makes you a little worse at spotting the one that is wrong."
H2 L1 "The more you trust it, the less you notice" vs L4 "makes you a little worse at spotting the one that is wrong"; body supports the header, nothing contradicts it.

Closest: L8 "The trust is deserved. The noticing still has to be designed." is a two-beat contrast, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' and no triple; no superlatives, no number+retraction, no empty-leg verb triplet; 'The noticing still has to be designed' is a vision claim attested in backing L22.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L6 'digest' and L8 'designed' are ordinary product-team words; grep for surface/firing/compendium/forcing function/beat/mood in body 1-11 shows none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-11 -> 0 bold elements; within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: file is not included by any training or module (grep of curriculum/trainings and modules finds no include), so no composed deck to verify

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or hand-numbered titles

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js -> 'OK — 55 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.'; body has no above/below/see-below pointer.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body; rule carries no gate

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/trust-grows-attention-fades.md -> '✓ every slide is within limits'; 4 paragraphs, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "The more you trust it, the less you notice" is a claim heading, the lecture-slide form.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L10 "ask the plain question: when did you last do this kind of work by hand?" could read as a kicker but adds a concrete move the slide did not hold (the question to ask), not a restatement of the header; L8 prescribes the habit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header L1 promises the trust/noticing trade-off; L4 states it, L6 evidences it, L8-10 act on it; no inherited bullet answers an old header. Maintainer STATUS L14 notes sentence cut in round 3 with claim kept.
